name: HOZO Calendar Portal identity binding
requiresDatabases: HOZO AM 2.0 enabled group member maps

dataIsolation.guard: Only an already-resolved HOZO AM 2.0 direct LINE event may consume a one-time code; Rental authorizes the active admin_users.id and stores no raw LINE user ID in logs or AMCore.

definitionOfDone: Rental creates a one-time five-minute binding code for the authenticated Portal user
AM accepts only the exact 綁定 123456 command from an existing safe private route
AM calls Rental with a dedicated machine token and Idempotency-Key
Rental creates one active identity link per LINE user and Portal person
Unknown, expired, reused, conflicting, inactive and unauthorized requests fail closed
Repeated requests with the same Idempotency-Key do not create duplicate links
No raw LINE user ID, token, code or private message is stored in AMCore
